model_meta.description: Model of the prepared-workspace evidence for US7763818B2 only. The requested US10036408B2 is not represented because no evidence for that patent is present. A planar bistable compliant input drives a spherical linkage for selective second-plane positioning.

subsystems.description: Four-bar planar compliant mechanism with input and output; exemplary Young mechanism uses rigid members and flexural compliant members to provide two stable configurations.

parts.description: First and second rigid members of the four-bar structure, including the respective first and second pin locations on those members (claims 2-3 and 14-15).
First and second compliant members of the four-bar structure (claims 2 and 14).

subsystems.description: Coupler and output links with a collapsible union convert planar input rotation into out-of-plane positioning/rotation; output link is hinged to a base substrate.

parts.description: Collapsible union, optionally a compliant torsional hinge

subsystems.description: Substrate providing the hinged, constrained coupling for the second end of the output link.
Optional reflective surface coupled to the spherical mechanism member for optical-switch application.

item_flows.name: Planar output motion to spherical mechanism
item_flows.notes: Planar member output drives the spherical mechanism coupler.

actions.name: Convert planar input to out-of-plane position

steps.description: Planar bistable member moves between stable configurations and supplies arcuate in-plane output motion.
Motion is transmitted to the coupler link; the collapsible union collapses as the links move normal to the formation plane.
The output link, constrained at its hinged substrate end, produces out-of-plane rotation/positioning.
